pit.effectiveUniverseRule: At each UTC daily scan timestamp T, eligible symbols are then-observed USDⓈ-M perpetuals with >=90d age, >=28 of the prior 30 daily bars, and positive quoteVolume24h; select top min(100,N) by the latest closed bar's quoteVolume24h with symbol tie-break.
